class.name: CgameLatencyProbe
class.brief_description: Input-to-photon latency statistics and photodiode pairing.
class.description: [CgameLatencyProbe] does the bookkeeping for measuring input-to-display latency in normal rendering and with frame generation. It does no rendering itself. [b]Workflow.[/b] The host calls [method mark_input] for every discrete input, shows a small corner rectangle in white while [method is_flash_on] is [code]true[/code], and calls [method mark_draw] after each presented frame. A sample completes at the first draw after its input. The software estimate is [code](draw - input) + half a refresh interval + display_offset_ms[/code]; it omits scan-out and pixel response and is a proxy for comparing modes and builds, not an absolute number. [b]Hardware measurement.[/b] A photodiode over the corner rectangle, read by a microcontroller, records the timestamp of each black-to-white edge on its own clock. [method import_photodiode_csv] or [method pair_photodiode] assigns each edge to the latest unmatched input before it; those samples then report [code]photodiode - input[/code]. This is also correct with frame generation. Set [member mode] before a run (the engine cannot detect frame generation) and compare the per-mode percentiles in [method report]. Samples are dictionaries [code]{mode, input_us, draw_us, photodiode_us}[/code]; unknown times are [code]-1[/code].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all samples and pending state.

method.name: estimate_display_ms
method.description: Returns the display time added to software estimates: half a refresh interval plus [member display_offset_ms]. A negative [param refresh_hz] queries the display server; if the refresh rate is unknown, 60 Hz is assumed.

method.name: get_pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of samples waiting for the next [method mark_draw].

method.name: import_photodiode_csv
method.description: Reads edge timestamps (microseconds on the external clock, one per line) from [param path], adds [param clock_offset_us] to map them to the engine clock and pairs them with the samples. Returns the number of pairs.

method.name: is_flash_on
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the host should show the corner rectangle in white.

method.name: latency_ms
method.description: Returns the latency of one sample in milliseconds, or [code]-1.0[/code] if it is incomplete. A photodiode time wins over the software estimate, which adds [param display_ms].

method.name: mark_draw
method.description: Completes all pending samples with the draw time [param now_us] (a negative value uses the current tick count), emits [signal sample_completed] for each and advances the flash. Returns how many samples completed.

method.name: mark_input
method.description: Timestamps an input at [param now_us] (a negative value uses the current tick count) and starts the flash. Returns the sample index, or [code]-1[/code] if the input came sooner than [member min_gap_ms] after the previous one.

method.name: pair_photodiode
method.description: Assigns each edge of [param edges_us] (plus [param clock_offset_us]) to the latest unmatched sample whose input precedes it by at most [param max_gap_us], and stores it as [code]photodiode_us[/code]. The sample dictionaries are modified in place. Returns the number of pairs.

method.name: percentile
method.description: Returns the linearly interpolated percentile ([code]0..100[/code]) of an ascending-sorted array, or [code]0.0[/code] for an empty array.

method.name: report
method.description: Returns the per-mode statistics of the recorded samples plus [code]refresh_hz[/code] and [code]display_offset_ms[/code]. See [method summarize].

method.name: save_report
method.description: Writes [method report] as JSON to [param path]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be written.

method.name: summarize
method.description: Returns [code]mode -> {count, min, avg, p50, p90, p95, p99, max, jitter, source}[/code] for complete samples. [code]source[/code] is [code]"photodiode"[/code] if every sample of the mode has a photodiode time, [code]"mixed"[/code] if some have, otherwise [code]"software"[/code].

members.member: Label stored in new samples, typically [code]"normal"[/code] or [code]"framegen"[/code].
Number of draws the corner rectangle stays white after an input.
Minimum time between two recorded inputs, in milliseconds. Closer inputs are ignored.
Extra display processing time added to software estimates, for example 5 to 15 ms for a TV in game mode.
If [code]false[/code], the host should not record inputs. The probe itself does not look at this flag.
